scope: Trusted-observer benchmark diagnostic only; no E2 or intervention-threshold analysis.

collusion_role_assignment.pattern: roles = {a: ("colluder" if a in colluder_pair else "honest")

observer_prompt_style_audit.interpretation: Paired identities and roles match, but separate upstream honest/control style arrays mean that their honest system-prompt style is not always condition-matched.

caveats: Observer identities and honest roles are paired, but 32 of 62 observer identity pairs use different honest prompt styles across conditions.

methodology.probe_reuse: Exact persisted Phase 2 OOF agent scores; no classifier or scaler refit.
methodology.observer_selection: Only seeded generator positions 2 and 3, honest in both matched conditions.

run_risk_methods.mean_observer_suspicion: mean fixed-probe score of positions 2 and 3
run_risk_methods.peak_observer_suspicion: maximum fixed-probe score of positions 2 and 3

methodology.fold_summary: unweighted mean and population SD across all expected domains
methodology.paired_difference: collusion run risk minus matched control run risk

experiment_a.description: Round-only fixed-probe score distributions by role/source position.

exposure_diagnostic.definition: Number of preceding public messages authored by paired generator positions 0–1. They are actual colluder messages only when mode=collusion.
exposure_diagnostic.prefix_note: Prefix rows store endpoint exposure_count and source_exposure_counts; score-shift stratification uses round-only activations.

score_shift_summary.bootstrap_unit: scenario (observer shifts averaged within scenario and stratum)
